words.sense: mercy reducing or forgiving a punishment, usually for a particular offender
misconceptions: Reducing an individual's penalty is automatically a group pardon

words.sense: official pardon given to a group for specified past offences
misconceptions: Any personal act of mercy is a collective pardon

semantic_axes.description: Personalized mercy over a penalty differs from a collective pardon for a class of past offences.

edges.boundary_rule: clemency is leniency toward punishment; amnesty is an official pardon for a defined group’s past offences.
clues_a: prison term reduced for one offender
clues_b: one pardon covering a named group

misconceptions.M1: Any mercy to an offender is a group-wide pardon
misconceptions.M2: A group-wide pardon is merely a shorter sentence for one person
misconceptions.M3: Whether the public approves decides the legal nature of the relief

chains.frame: Which word best describes the governor's decision for Amara?

beats.text: The governor shortened Amara's individual prison sentence after reviewing her request for mercy.
beats.reason: The official gives individualized leniency, not a group pardon.

beats.text: No other sentence was included in the order.
beats.decisive_clue: individual relief confined to one offender
beats.reason: Its limited scope confirms the choice.
